posts.title: Unsubscribed for the Night: Late-night moody trap-soul to exhale to
posts.feed_hook:
Battery's low.
So are the lights.

posts.instagram:
Battery's low. So are the lights.

On the cover of Unsubscribed for the Night, the shadow of someone in headphones, one hand behind their head, falls across a dim amber wall. In front of it sit a phone showing a crescent moon and a nearly empty battery, and a pair of headphones set down for the night. It's late-night, moody trap-soul from DJ Bombchelle.

Play it on a Wednesday night when you're done answering anybody.

Turn it up.

On the cover of Turn Up The Soca Vol 1, DJ decks glow at the edge of a beach at sunset, with speakers stacked on one side and palm trees leaning over the water. It's high-energy soca for parties and dancing from DJ Bombchelle.

Put it on to start your Friday night, even if the beach is a Boston kitchen in November.
